name: 06_save_and_update_db
task: In 1C Configurator: the extension 'api' (tab 'Api *' at the bottom) has unsaved changes. Save it and update the database configuration so the changes are applied (the user has approved this).
rules: Do not change or delete any objects. Work only with the extension 'Api'. When 1C asks 'Сохранить изменения?' or shows a list of changes with a button 'Принять', confirm with 'Да' / 'Принять'. Never click 'Удалить'.

subgoals.goal: Click the button 'OK' in the message 'Сохранение конфигурации в файл ... завершено'.
subgoals.check: No message box with the text 'Сохранение конфигурации в файл' is visible.

subgoals.goal: Activate the extension window: click the tab 'Api *' at the bottom-left of the Configurator window (in the task bar of open windows, just above the status bar).
subgoals.check: The tree of the extension 'api' (root node 'api') is visible and active, or the bottom tab 'Api *' is highlighted as the active window.

subgoals.goal: Open the main menu 'Конфигурация' (4th item of the top menu bar: Файл, Правка, Текст, Конфигурация ...) and click 'Обновить конфигурацию базы данных'. If 1C asks whether to save changes, answer 'Да'. If a window with a list of changes and a button 'Принять' appears, click 'Принять'.
subgoals.check: The bottom tab reads 'Api' WITHOUT an asterisk, or a message says the update is completed, and no dialog asking a question is open.
